findings.detail: EN 'He considers these tournaments beneath his time' vs RU 'Он считает такие турниры ниже своего времени': literal calque is nonsensical in Russian; render as a waste of future king's time or below his dignity.

EN 'Andrew could use a little less scheduling and considerably more sunlight' vs RU 'чуть меньше расписания': awkward literalism; use a natural formulation about less time spent on schedules and more time in the sun.

EN 'Caleb’s heart drops, as though something has physically fallen through his chest and landed somewhere beneath his stomach' vs RU 'Сердце Калеба падает, словно физически проваливается куда-то ниже живота': unnatural calque, restore sinking dread with natural Russian figurative language.

EN 'I may not work for the Crown ... But I am the Crown's appointed enforcer' rendered 'назначенный Короной силовой исполнитель': technical bureaucratic calque, wrong dialogue register; convey appointed enforcement authority naturally.
Author note EN 'I’m just way too obsessed with Caleb and Arian' vs RU 'Я совершенно помешана': the original gives no author gender; use neutral grammar such as 'Я просто без ума от Калеба и Ариана'.
